text:
Hello,

I'm not after money from my landlord. Nothing of mine has been damaged, I haven't had any extra expenses because of this, and I'm not claiming any compensation. I just want the flat to be usable again.

I've attached the notes and photos I've been keeping since it started.

What I have done is stop paying my rent to Birkenrain Trading Ltd. A neighbour explained that you can pay it into an official deposit account instead while a problem isn't fixed, and that is what I'm doing now and will keep doing.

Whether Birkenrain actually knows about the problem is something I really can't tell you. Several tenants in the building have the same issue and I assume someone has been in touch with Ms Kate Ellis, but I have no idea whether that's true, and nobody from Birkenrain has shown up or said a word.

The problem itself: since 6 August 2026 there has been a strong sewage smell coming up through the drains in the bathroom and the kitchen of my flat at Seestrasse 1 in Liestal. On warm days it's so bad that I can't cook, and I've been eating at my partner Alice Shaw's place most evenings. The bathroom door has to stay shut and the window open around the clock, even at night. Sometimes the shower drain gurgles and dirty water comes back up.

The September rent of CHF 1500 is already paid into the deposit account at the cantonal office. I have the receipt. Is there anything else I need to do to make sure I'm doing this correctly?

Thanks in advance,
Owen Rüegg

Record kept by Owen Rüegg, Seestrasse 1, Liestal

6 August 2026, evening: strong sewage smell in the bathroom, coming from the floor drain and the washbasin. Photo 1: floor drain. Photo 2: washbasin overflow.

9 August 2026: same smell now also in the kitchen, from the sink drain. Cooking impossible because of the smell. Photo 3.

17 August 2026: shower drain gurgles, grey water comes back up into the shower tray after flushing the toilet. Photo 4 and Photo 5.

30 August 2026: smell unchanged. Bathroom door kept shut and window open day and night; cannot sleep with bedroom door open. Kitchen not used for meals since 9 August.

All photos with date stamp from the phone camera.
